    Riedtmann conditions for the standard-form mesh category #

    This file descends the covering properties of the normalized universal realization to the standard-form mesh category. The first step compares its Hom spaces with the corresponding Hom spaces between the chosen indecomposable modules by reindexing the common fibres of the universal mesh projection and the normalized realization.
